name: eBird Basic Dataset (EBD)
description: The eBird Basic Dataset (EBD) is the world's largest biodiversity citizen science dataset, managed by the Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Updated monthly, the EBD contains more than 1.4 billion bird observation records submitted by hundreds of thousands of birders worldwide. Each observation includes species identity, count, precise latitude/longitude, timestamp, and crucially, sampling effort metadata (duration, distance traveled, protocol type) enabling statistical modeling of species distributions, migratory corridors, and population abundances while controlling for observer effort.
